items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I never met Milt until years later.

ctx.x: It was on the South Side.
The South Side. That’s what I wondered, because how did that affect . . . did you meet people like . . . or maybe he was already . . . no, Milt Hinton and that group was already gone at that point.
I never met Milt until years later. I didn’t meet any of those people. I guess I met Dizzy in the ’50s.

items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: There was five piano players, you remember? ... Marian McPartland

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, friends of Ellington. Yeah.
There was five piano players, you remember? Five piano players. Willie “The Lion”, Earl Hines, Marian McPartland, and Hank Jones. And the drummer was Louie Bellson. Jim Hall was the guitar player—
And Dizzy Gillespie was just in the audience. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
